title: Fix Norwegian SAF-T 1.30 debit and credit totals
summary: Norwegian SAF-T 1.30 export now correctly calculates debit and credit totals from actual G/L entry amounts instead of stored columns, ensuring totals match exported line amounts even with reversals or negative entries.
key_points: Debit and credit totals in SAF-T 1.30 now calculated from G/L Amount using SQL aggregation instead of stored debit/credit columns
Fixes discrepancies when exports contain reversals or negative entries
Complete selection totals are repeated in every split file for consistency
Extensive test coverage added for reversals, negative entries, multiple journals, and split scenarios
quote: Calculate debit and credit totals from positive and negative G/L Amount using SQL aggregation and the exporter's journal filters.
